question: In a certain code language, ‘HYPOCRISY’ is written as ‘YPHOCIRYS’, and ‘IMPORTANT’ is written as ‘MPIORATTN’. How will ‘INTEGRITY’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is : 

 
• First letter - Shifted to the third position.
 
• Second letter - Shifted to first position.
 
• Third letter - Shifted to second position.
 
• Fourth and fifth letter - No change
 
• Sixth and seventh letter - Interchange position with each other.
 
• Eighth and ninth letter - Interchange position with each other.

So,

 
• ‘HYPOCRISY’ is written as ‘YPHOCIRYS’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79627af6febf085331bc2f685f8b65e08750b0bb873fd526c36ca676483ebebf.png] ​

And,

 
• ‘IMPORTANT’ is written as ‘MPIORATTN’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d6b490307626ddcc4963f63951d7af7455bb639bb201fcd8ba9e43a81e82be7.png] ​

​Similarly,

 
• ‘INTEGRITY’ is written as : 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f95be0051f3b448df6dbc5e0698f58ffa0b3eb317bfb25c1742350aca688465.png] ​

​Hence, "**NTIEGIRYT**" is the correct answer.
